overall_reason: Clamped changelog entries link to their full text, empty slots leave no hole and the layout fits every width, but the page makes 248 requests with LCP 3.5 s and a sixth of its text needs script.

score.reason: T-TRUNCATION, T-HOSTILE-CONTENT and T-WIDTHS pass; T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB (ROB-018, 248 requests) and T-NO-SCRIPT (ROB-015) fail.

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.evidence: performance: 248 requests (requests fail; budget 60 to 110), 197 of them script files and 46 stylesheets; bytes are known for only 3 of 248. The sweep's performance hit (WEB-001) records lab LCP 3488 ms (warn over 2500).
findings.before: The home page fetches about two hundred script chunks before the hero settles.
findings.after: Bundle the landing route's scripts into a few chunks and defer the product-demo panels until they scroll into view.
findings.why: On a phone line each request costs a round trip; the LCP is already past the 2.5 s warning in the lab.

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Product demo panels and lower sections, all widths
findings.evidence: resilience.hidden_content.scripts_off: 5573 of 7149 characters visible (74.9% of baseline); the sweep's hidden_content hit (ROB-001, Floor) records 1102 characters (17%) invisible with JavaScript off.
findings.before: A sixth of the page's text appears only after script runs.
findings.after: Ship the demo copy in the server HTML and let script animate it, not create it.
findings.why: Visitors whose bundle fails, or search previews, lose the product descriptions that sell the page.

strengths: Changelog descriptions clamp to two lines with an ellipsis and each entry links to its full page (tiles/1440-08.png); the 'Mobile Diffs' entry has no description and leaves no hole.
The stylesheet declares 12 ellipsis classes and 3 line-clamp classes, and has [dir="rtl"] and [dir="ltr"] rules with 303 logical properties.
The hero heading wraps cleanly at 375 (tiles/375-00.png) and the document matches every viewport width.
The demo's primary actions answer within 0.5 s when held slow (resilience.async).
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long names, translations and missing images are reasoned from layout evidence, not observed
right-to-left render: not captured; readiness read from the stylesheet only
page load on a throttled line: only actions were held slow
layout shift as a number: this capture predates CLS recording
computed text-overflow per element: absent in this capture; ellipsis rows come from class rules and were checked on tiles
widths between the captures, 320px and landscape
regions behind menus, tabs, dialogs or a login that the capture did not open
true page weight: bytes known for 3 of 248 requests
the failed path for the demo actions: the slow run made no same-origin request, so there was nothing to fail
the visually hidden h1 span (1px box, 'The product development system for teams and agents') is screen-reader text, not a clipped label
the 935 words hidden at 375 are the sweep's phone_parity hit (ROB-002): the product mock is cropped on phones
the footer legal row (Privacy, Terms, Other Policies, DPA, AUP) has 1px free at 1280; footer, not raised
contract: no 00-contract.md; inferred a Persuade product home page, English, international audience
